name: scene_preview
title: Inspect rendered FX scene frames
description: Renders exact frames of a saved scene in a contained browser and returns real MCP PNG images. The snapshot binds source revision, settings, assets and runtime; it uses the same programmable scene contract as FX Studio. Without project_id/brand_id it previews for account FX authoring. at_ms selects explicit scene times; burst selects an evenly spaced set. contact_sheet returns one tiled image. This renders preview evidence without changing the scene, production defaults or an Episode.

project_id.description: Project public ID; this is the account boundary for the scene and brand.

scene_id.description: Account scene id written by scene_write.

recipe.description: Optional recipe object; scene_id/scene may be read from it.

brand_id.description: Checked-in brand id or account pack id returned by brand_pack_write.

at_ms.description: Exact scene times in milliseconds, including fractional frame boundaries. Max 6.

burst.description: Alternative to at_ms: {count, duration_ms}. Max count 6.

aspect.description: Preview aspect. Defaults to the saved scene aspect.

contact_sheet.description: When true, model-visible content returns one tiled PNG contact sheet instead of individual frame image blocks. Per-frame data URLs remain in private app hydration and web-bridge results.

examples.label: Preview the reveal at start, peak, and hold

frames.description: Frame metadata with phase, width, height and byte_size. Web-bridge results also include data_url; MCP app hydration receives it privately.

model_image_delivery.description: How MCP image content was delivered: frames, sampled_frames, contact_sheet, or none.

model_image_count.description: Number of model-visible image content blocks returned alongside text labels.

content_bytes.description: Approximate bytes of model-visible PNG image content before JSON/base64 overhead.

project_id.description: Project public ID the preview was rendered for; null for an account-level preview.

account_id.description: Account public ID that owns the scene.

aspect.description: Canvas aspect ratio of the preview, such as 16:9 or 1:1.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previewed scene source.

snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full preview snapshot: source, brand and settings.

blockers.description: Typed blockers; empty when the call succeeded.
